occurrences.source_text: Shift of Hematology CTCAE Grade from Baseline to Worst Post-baseline
Note: The baseline value is defined to be the last non-missing assessment on/before the date of the first ARV- 471/anastrozole dose.
Note: Grade is derived using CTCAE 5.0.
Each Test starts from a new page
